This ARGB build also hands the fan lighting to your motherboard's ARGB header
when it starts. On a controller that does not keep its lighting in its own
memory (the UNI FAN SL-Infinity 120 V1, for one) the lighting resets to the
factory rainbow every time the plugin starts. If you do not want that, use the
Standard build (FanControl.LianLi.dll). Install only one build at a time.
